name: Title and bullets
useWhen: Default. A short explanation in 1 to 3 points, with no standout number or picture.

name: Split: points beside a picture or number
useWhen: Points that a matching image or one number backs up.

name: Big number
useWhen: The answer is one headline number: price, users, revenue, growth.

name: Picture first
useWhen: Showing beats telling: a product screenshot, a diagram, a chart page.

name: One-line statement
useWhen: One bold claim, like the mission or what the product does in a sentence.

name: Three side by side
useWhen: Exactly three parallel items: three features, three steps, three customer types.
